verdict.rationale: The Jobs API documents a per-job option that immediately redacts the input_url and deletes transcript segments after 12 hours, so the product gives users some first-party control over retention. That control is a single fixed toggle, and there is no evidence of an on-demand delete endpoint, configurable retention windows, or account-level deletion. Missing for 10: explicit job/transcript delete API, configurable retention periods, account-wide retention or deletion settings, documented default retention policy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: When enabled, immediately redacts the original input_url and deletes the segments after 12 hours.
